Function Probe() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet, c As PivotCache, p As Object, f As PivotField
Set ws=Worksheets(1)
ws.Range("A1:B1").Value=Array("Region","Amount")
ws.Range("A2:B2").Value=Array("East",10)
ws.Range("A3:B3").Value=Array("West",20)
ws.Range("A4:B4").Value=Array("East",30)
ws.Range("A5:B5").Value=Array("West",40)
ws.Range("A6:B6").Value=Array("East",50)
On Error GoTo Failed
Set c=ThisWorkbook.PivotCaches.Create(xlDatabase,ws.Range("A1:B6"))
Set p=c.CreatePivotTable(ws.Range("E3"),"Made")
Set f=p.AddDataField(2)
Probe=f.Name & "|" & CStr(f.Function) & "|" & CStr(p.DataFields.Count) & "|" & p.TableRange1.Address
Exit Function
Failed:
Probe="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & CStr(p.DataFields.Count)
End Function

classes.AggregateSink:

End Sub

Log=Log & "pivot:" & Target.Name & ":" & CStr(Target.DataFields.Count) & ";"
End Sub

Function Probe() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet, c As PivotCache, p As PivotTable, f As PivotField
Set ws=Worksheets(1)

ws.Range("A2:B2").Value=Array("East",10)
ws.Range("A3:B3").Value=Array("West",20)
ws.Range("A4:B4").Value=Array("East",30)
ws.Range("A5:B5").Value=Array("West",40)
ws.Range("A6:B6").Value=Array("East",50)
On Error GoTo Failed

Set c=ThisWorkbook.PivotCaches.Create(xlDatabase,ws.Range("A1:B6"))
Set p=c.CreatePivotTable(ws.Range("E3"),"Made")
Dim caption As String
caption=ChrW(&HD83D) & ChrW(&HDE00)
Set f=p.AddDataField(p.PivotFields("Amount"),caption,xlSum)
Probe=HexText(f.Name) & "|" & CStr(f.Name=caption) & "|" & HexText(CStr(ws.Range("E3").Value2)) & "|" & CStr(f.Name=ws.Range("E3").Value2) & "|" & CStr(p.DataFields(caption).Function) & "|" & CStr(p.GetPivotData(caption).Value2) & "|" & CStr(StrComp(caption,ChrW(&HE000),vbBinaryCompare)) & "|" & CStr(caption<ChrW(&HE000))
Exit Function
Failed:
Probe="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number)
End Function
Function HexText(ByVal value As String) As String
Dim i As Long
For i=1 To Len(value)
HexText=HexText & Right$("0000" & Hex$(AscW(Mid$(value,i,1)) And &HFFFF&),4)
Next
End Function
